findings.summary: InkWell borderRadius is 12 while the design-system Card radius is 20, so the tap ripple overflows/clips against the rounded card corners.
findings.fix: Change BorderRadius.circular(12) to BorderRadius.circular(20) to match the theme Card radius (or read it from the CardTheme).

findings.summary: The empty state stacks a full-width left-aligned Icon above a centered Text (icon not centered, no spacing, no muted color or brand mark), which is inconsistent with the polished empty states used elsewhere.
findings.fix: Wrap the empty state in a Center + Column (mainAxisSize.min) with the icon colored scheme.onSurfaceVariant, a SizedBox gap, and the message styled from textTheme; consider a BrandLogoMark header for brand consistency.

findings.summary: The error state is a bare left/center Text with the raw '$error' string and no error icon or retry affordance, inconsistent with a design-system error state.
findings.fix: Show a centered Column with Icon(Icons.error_outline, color: scheme.error), a friendly message, and a retry TextButton that calls ref.invalidate(mobileFeedProvider); avoid interpolating the raw exception.

findings.summary: Title uses a hardcoded TextStyle(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: w900) instead of the theme text scale, bypassing Cairo/text-theme sizing.
findings.fix: Use Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900) so it inherits the design-system type scale.

findings.summary: Body text uses a hardcoded TextStyle(height: 1.7) with no color, not derived from the theme text scale.
findings.fix: Use Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(height: 1.7, color: scheme.onSurfaceVariant) for consistent typography and dark-theme contrast.

findings.summary: The acknowledgement status Icon has no Semantics label/tooltip and the check/eye icon relies purely on shape to convey acknowledged vs pending.
findings.fix: Wrap the Icon in Semantics(label: item.myAcknowledged ? 'تم الإقرار بالاطلاع' : 'يتطلب الاطلاع والإقرار') and give it a meaningful color (scheme.primary when acknowledged).

findings.summary: The empty-state icon uses the default icon color with no theme color, so it renders as full-opacity onSurface rather than a muted placeholder.
findings.fix: Set color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant on the Icons.campaign_outlined icon.

findings.summary: Loading state uses a fixed SizedBox(height: 260) magic offset to vertically position the spinner, which is fragile across viewport sizes.
findings.fix: Replace with a Center/Padding-based layout (e.g. Padding(top: 120) or a full-height Center) so the spinner centers responsively.
